<thought>We need to determine the number of aromatic carbon atoms in the unknown molecule. The most direct way is to obtain its 13C NMR spectrum and count the signals that fall in the typical aromatic region (≈120–150 ppm). This requires a single measurement, which is acceptable given the cost constraints.</thought>
